title: Helix TaskSet
description: plan/taskset.yaml: the lanes (repositories) the loop builds and, in each, its epics in order. Each task names its epic's key in `epic`; its lane is its `repo`.

stages.description: Optional milestones, in order. A task names its stage in `stage`; work in a later stage waits until every earlier stage is settled. Leave this out for no stage gating.

title.description: How the stage reads, e.g. "Day 1: Foundation".

timelines.description: The finish dates the loop's app shows: [code, project] (both, the default) or [project]. Project complete is when everything is done, human tasks and their lead times included; code complete is when the last builder task would merge if every human task were done when it is needed, so a wait for an account or a D-U-N-S number doesn't count against the build.

repo.description: The repository the lane builds, as tasks name it in `repo`.

epics.description: The lane's epics, keyed by epic key, in the order they are built.

title.description: The capability the epic delivers, in plain words.

stage.description: Optional: the stage, one of `stages`, when every task in the epic is in it. Epics group by capability; a stage is a milestone, not a level of the hierarchy.
